text: Agnes 多模态工具是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，通过注册工具提供图片生成、视频生成和可选的图片识别。图片工具可根据文字提示生成图片，也可结合参考图编辑或合成；视频工具支持文字、首尾帧及参考素材模式，并在任务完成后下载视频。识图工具可接收本地图片或 URL，返回文字结果。生成文件保存在本地配置目录，默认使用 DSH 主目录下的 media。需要 Agnes API Key，可通过插件配置、DSH 凭据库或 AGNES_API_KEY 环境变量提供。

Agnes Multimodal Tools adds image and video generation and optional image recognition to DSH. Create images from prompts or references; generate videos from text, keyframes, or reference media. Files are saved locally. Recognition accepts images or URLs and returns text. Requires an Agnes API key.
想根据文字描述生成或修改图片，并把成品保存到本地。
让 DSH 按提示词、首尾帧或参考素材生成一段视频。
I want DSH to describe a picture or extract text from an image file.
Agnes 多模态工具的功能「图片生成与编辑」：通过图片工具提交提示词，可选提供参考图片进行编辑或多图合成；生成图片会保存到本地目录，结果提供文件路径与 URL。
Agnes 多模态工具的功能「视频生成」：调用视频工具并选择文字、首尾帧或参考素材模式；插件等待异步任务完成后将视频下载到本地目录，并返回文件路径和视频 URL。
Agnes 多模态工具需要 Agnes API Key；插件会向 api.agnes-ai.cn 发送图片识别、图片生成或视频生成请求。

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · @lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes：Agnes AI **image generation** and **video generation** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/DeepSeek-Harness) — plus an **optional** image recognition that can be switched off.

> **Tool results are text-only.** Generated images and videos are downloaded to a local folder; the tool returns the file path and the URL, never the image bytes.

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Install：~~~sh
dsh plugin add github:lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes
~~~

This is the same command the DSH plugin marketplaces print. The package has no build
step, so nothing has to be approved before it installs.

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Configure：Open **Plugins → @lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes** in the Web UI and paste your Agnes API key, or use the DSH credential store:

~~~yaml

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · ~/.dsh/credentials.yaml  (or the credential store in the Web UI)：AGNES_API_KEY: your-key
~~~

The key is looked up in this order: the plugin config (`config.apiKey`) → the credential store entry `AGNES_API_KEY` → the environment variable `AGNES_API_KEY`.

> The key you type in the settings page is written to your **own profile** as `config.apiKey` in plain text. It is never written into the package, and the package ships without any credential.
section: ~/.dsh/credentials.yaml  (or the credential store in the Web UI)

text:
@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Tools：| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `agnes_image_generate` (main) | Generates or edits an image from a text prompt | `prompt`, `size`, `ratio`, `references`, `saveTo` |
| `agnes_video_generate` (main) | Generates a video from a text prompt | `prompt`, `mode`, `seconds`, `size`, `aspectRatio`, `images`, `saveTo` |
| `agnes_image_recognize` (optional) | Describes or answers questions about an image | `image` (local path or http(s) URL), `prompt` |

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Models：| Capability | Default model | Do you need to change it? |
|---|---|---|
| Recognition | `agnes-3.0-flash` | No — recognition runs on a chat model with vision; the default is multimodal and free |
| Image generation | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | No — it supports every size tier, every ratio and reference images |
| Video generation | `agnes-video-2.5` | **Yes, if you want the free tier** — `agnes-video-2.5-flash` is free but outputs 720P only and cannot take a reference video |

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Models：You can change all three from the plugin page (plugin → this package → page → “Models”).
The whole image model line is currently free. Model list and prices: https://www.agnes-ai.cn/zh-Hans/docs/overview

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Optional: image recognition：> **Statement.** Recognition works without changing the provider: this tool is independent of whether DSH
> talks to Agnes over `openai-responses` or `openai-completions`. Only DSH’s own
> `read_image` requires the provider to be switched to `openai-completions`; without that switch, do not
> give the model image input, because one `read_image` bricks the whole conversation.

@lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Do not use `read_image` inside the main conversation：> Once a model is marked as supporting images, the built-in `read_image` puts an image content block into
> the conversation. The Agnes gateway `/v1/responses` endpoint does not understand `input_image`
> (its responses→chat bridge falls back to `unknown`), so the next request fails with a 400. A 400 is
> not retried, and every turn rebuilds the whole history from the session log — one bad message bricks
> the entire conversation and you have to start a new one. Use `agnes_image_recognize` instead: the
> image goes to the Agnes vision model and only text comes back into the conversation.
section: Do not use `read_image` inside the main conversation

text: @lingxinsuixing/dsh-agnes README · Where output goes：Local images read by the recognition tool can be restricted with `allowedReadRoots` (a list of absolute folders). Empty = any readable image file is accepted.
